profileLabel: Pro-accountability institutions (medium confidence); mixed-to-slight-left economics (low confidence)
summary: Oriental Mindoro 2nd District representative with 103 principal-authored bills. Authored a right-to-information act (two bills), an independent flood-control investigation, a truth commission on extrajudicial killings, a political-party subsidy fund, a mining-free Mindoro, Verde Island marine protection, a special economic zone authority and a violence-against-women definition. Co-authored the national minimum wage.
caveat: Economic score mixes a mining ban and co-authored wages with a pro-investment economic zone. Bill-based; no votes. Violence-against-women bill alone does not make social values scorable.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored a mining-free zone for Mindoro (-2) and co-authored national minimum wage (-2), offset by a special economic zone authority (+1) and waste-to-energy framework (+1). Mixed; three issues.
